title: The Kettle War
description: On 8 October 1784 Habsburg and Dutch forces met in the Kettle War, named because the only shot fired hit a soup kettle. Emperor Joseph II wanted the Scheldt reopened, which the Dutch had closed since 1585. After a single shot Le Louis surrendered, and the dispute led to the 1785 Treaty of Fontainebleau. Source: Wikipedia, Kettle War.
pinned_comment: Fun fact: the Dutch later paid about 2 million guilders (some sources say 10 million) in the 1785 treaty. A whole war over one kettle 🍲 What's the smallest war you know?
